Subject: Exceptional Service During My Recent Stay

Dear [Hotel Manager's Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to express my sincere appreciation for the outstanding service I experienced during my recent stay at [Hotel Name] from [Check-in Date] to [Check-out Date]. From the moment I arrived, the staff went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction.

I would like to specifically highlight the efforts of [Employee Name 1] at the front desk, who greeted me with such warmth and efficiency, and [Employee Name 2] in the restaurant, whose attentive service and friendly demeanor made my breakfasts a highlight of the trip. Their professionalism and genuine care truly set your hotel apart.

Because of the exceptional experience I had, I will certainly be recommending [Hotel Name] to my colleagues and friends. It is rare to find such consistent excellence in hospitality, and I look forward to returning in the future.

Thank you again for making my stay so memorable.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Phone Number]
[Your Email Address]
